svg.title: Agentic Experience Studio architecture and flow
svg.desc: Seven stages from brief to handoff, with human decisions at spec approval and review, supported by a context layer, a library and records, and controls across everything. Status badges show what is built.
svg.text: From a designer’s idea to a tested, handed-off prototype
Agents draft, humans decide. What the studio generates is Nightingale; the studio’s own look is Fluid Intelligence.
fails: the agent refines, with a loop cap
what research learns becomes the next brief or refinement
what the agent must build with · feeds Spec and Build
Official React package: waiting on D2.
Protected files the agent cannot edit.
Fictional data only, five screen states:
Who asked, model, cost per run.
Limits and the kill switch read it.
Status: 15 Nov 2026. Live: front door, template preview, brief intake (dry run), conformance and accessibility gates, run limits. Open decisions D1–D9: docs/decisions.md
